title: Totem messages!
description: A simple lightweight datapack that adds a message whenever a player uses a totem of undying
body:
A simple lightweight datapack that sends a message whenever a player uses a totem of undying. Easily customizable, you can customise the message in the loop.mcfunction file![Totem message](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bf82e12b98fb7e9b833c44829bd70bc378d8f908.jpeg)

So what are you waiting for? get this datapack and add a spice to your hardcore forever world or your server!
